title: Density lower bounds pull back from a scaled restriction to the original varifold
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N and W an n-varifold on Ω ⊆ ℝ^N (so Ω is open). Let c ∈ [0,∞] with c ≠ 0 and c ≠ ∞, and suppose W.measure = c • V.measure⌞(Ω × G(N,n)). Suppose also that for μ_W-a.e. y there is θ with HasDensity n μ_W y θ and 1 ≤ θ. Then for μ_V-a.e. y: if y ∈ Ω, there is θ with HasDensity n μ_V y θ and c⁻¹ ≤ θ.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U Ω : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (W : Varifold N n Ω) (c : ℝ≥0∞), c ≠ 0 → c ≠ ∞ → W.measure = c • V.measure.restrict (Ω ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → (∀ᵐ y ∂W.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n W.weight y θ ∧ 1 ≤ θ) → ∀ᵐ y ∂V.weight, y ∈ Ω → ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n V.weight y θ ∧ c⁻¹ ≤ θ
